remarks: Discover this beautiful paired home on a desirable cul-de-sac in Glendale's sought-after Rancho San Rafael community. Step through the front double doors into an expansive, open floor plan highlighted by soaring cathedral ceilings, oversized windows, and abundant natural light. A cozy fireplace adds warmth and charm to the inviting living space. The spacious kitchen features abundant cabinetry and stainless steel appliances and opens seamlessly to the dining area and family room. Step outside to your own private backyard. A separate laundry area adds convenience. Upstairs, an open loft-style hallway overlooks the main living area, enhancing the home's spacious feel and architectural appeal.
